ostler --full-ids todo add
  Queue an epic, last or first, by its folder name or its slug.
  runs: ostler --full-ids todo add {name} [--front]
  body: AddArgs
  0 → lines of text: the epic is queued, with a warning when it has no epic.md yet
  1 → lines of text: the epic is already in the queue, matched by number or by slug
  carries: AddEpic
    refuses 1 "epic '{canonical}' already in the queue"
      why: adding an epic twice would run it twice, so the queue refuses the second.

ostler --full-ids todo prune
  Drop an epic from the queue.
  runs: ostler --full-ids todo prune {name}
  body: PruneArgs
  0 → lines of text: the queued epic is dropped, named as the queue spelled it
  1 → lines of text: the queue does not hold the epic
  carries: PruneEpic
    refuses 1 "epic '{name}' not in the queue"

ostler --full-ids todo reorder
  Move the named epics to the front of the queue in the order given; the rest keep their order after them.
  runs: ostler --full-ids todo reorder {first} {then}
  body: ReorderArgs
  0 → lines of text: the queue is reordered
  1 → lines of text: the queue does not hold a named epic; the message lists those it lacks, as typed
  carries: ReorderEpics
    refuses 1 'not in queue: {first}, {then}'
    refuses 1 'not in queue: {first}'
    refuses 1 'not in queue: {then}'

ostler --full-ids todo list
  Print the queue, one epic per line, first to last.
  runs: ostler --full-ids todo list
  body: ListArgs
  0 → lines of text: the queued epics, or (none) when the queue is empty
  carries: ListEpics

ostler --full-ids seed add
  List a seed under an epic's Seeds, or replace the one that has the id.
  runs: ostler --full-ids seed add {epic} {seed} --status {status} --layer {layer}
  body: SeedAddArgs
  0 → lines of text: the seed is added, or replaced at the end of the Seeds section
  1 → lines of text: the epic does not exist, or the status or the layer is not one the registry lists
  carries: AddSeed
    refuses 1 "no epic '{epic}'"
    refuses 1 "invalid status '{status}' (one of backlog, researched, covered, resolved, dropped, deferred)"
    refuses 1 "invalid layer '{layer}' (one of frontend, backend, infra)"

ostler --full-ids seed remove
  Take a seed out of an epic's Seeds.
  runs: ostler --full-ids seed remove {epic} {seed}
  body: SeedRemoveArgs
  0 → lines of text: the seed is removed
  1 → lines of text: the epic does not exist, or it lists no seed with the id
  carries: RemoveSeed
    refuses 1 "no epic '{epic}'"
    refuses 1 "no seed '{seed}' in '{epic}'"

ostler --full-ids set-status
  Set a story's status in its frontmatter and in its Implementation Status line.
  runs: ostler --full-ids set-status {story} {status}
  body: SetStatusArgs
  0 → lines of text: the status is set
  1 → lines of text: no story has the id
  carries: SetStoryStatus
    refuses 1 "no story with id '{story}'"

ostler --full-ids conflict
  Record the conflict found in a story's acceptance criteria, or clear it.
  runs: ostler --full-ids conflict {story} {text} [--clear]
  body: ConflictArgs
  0 → lines of text: the conflict is recorded or cleared
  1 → lines of text: the text and --clear are both given or both left out, or no story has the id
  carries: RecordConflict
    refuses 1 'pass the conflict text, or --clear — one of the two'
    refuses 1 "no story with id '{story}'"

ostler --full-ids path epic
  Print where an epic lives, relative to the repository.
  runs: ostler --full-ids path epic {name}
  body: PathEpicArgs
  0 → lines of text: the epic's folder, whether or not it exists
  carries: PathOfEpic

sandbox files
  List the watched files of the sandbox with the strings each holds.
  auth: none
  0 → [File]: every watched file with the strings it holds
  carries: ListFiles

GroomTheQueue\nA planner shapes the order the repo works its epics. They list the queue, queue the third epic by its slug, then\n    put it first, move the second ahead of the rest, drop the first, and find where the third epic lives.
WriteSeeds\nA planner lists two seeds under the second epic, rewrites the first with a status and a layer, and takes both\n    out again. The watch reads the epic's page after each step.

TrackAStory\nA planner moves the story alpha through its statuses, records a conflict in its criteria, replaces the conflict\n    with another, and clears it. A second story keeps its own status throughout.

WrongTurns
A planner slips. They queue an epic twice, prune and reorder epics the queue lacks, queue an epic that has no
    folder yet, list a seed with a status and a layer the registry lacks, remove a seed that is not there, and
    name a story that does not exist or give a conflict no text.
- **first > second**: the queue holds the two epics it starts with. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **first > second > third**: the third epic is queued last. Reached by: ostler --full-ids todo add third.
- **third > first > second**: the third epic is queued first. Reached by: ostler --full-ids todo add 0003-third --front.
- **second > first**: the second epic was moved ahead of the first. Reached by: ostler --full-ids todo reorder 0002-second.
- **empty**: both epics were pruned. Reached by: ostler --full-ids todo prune 0001-first; ostler --full-ids todo prune 0002-second.
- **Not started**: the story has not begun. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **in-progress**: the story is in progress. Reached by: ostler --full-ids set-status TST-01M585P7WKBH9YJ8E6NA73W4S9 in-progress.
- **Blocked: waiting**: the story is blocked. Reached by: ostler --full-ids set-status TST-01M585P7WKBH9YJ8E6NA73W4S9 'Blocked: waiting'.
- **Not started with conflict**: a conflict is recorded on the story. Reached by: ostler --full-ids conflict TST-01M585P7WKBH9YJ8E6NA73W4S9 'criteria disagree'.

- **in-progress with conflict**: the story is in progress and a conflict is recorded. Reached by: ostler --full-ids set-status TST-01M585P7WKBH9YJ8E6NA73W4S9 in-progress; ostler --full-ids conflict TST-01M585P7WKBH9YJ8E6NA73W4S9 'criteria disagree'.
- **no seeds**: the epic lists no seeds. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **SD-3**: the epic lists the seed SD-3. Reached by: ostler --full-ids seed add 0002-second SD-3.
- **SD-3 + SD-4**: the epic lists the seeds SD-3 and SD-4. Reached by: ostler --full-ids seed add 0002-second SD-3; ostler --full-ids seed add 0002-second SD-4 --status researched --layer frontend.
A bare slug of an epic that exists on disk (`second`) resolves to its numbered directory (`0002-second`) in
`todo add`, `todo prune`, `todo reorder` and `path epic`. A name with no folder stays as typed, and `todo add`
queues it with a warning that epic selection will skip it. The queue record therefore keeps canonical names, and
the fixtures carry a `canonical` property so a rule's message prints the name the tool prints.
